recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: autumn clear night over san francisco
thirteen-degree wind drifting off the bay
spinning up agents from a pocket screen

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Flash thought fragments rain down a terminal screen — catch the coherent insight shards before they dissolve, dodge the noise decoys.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each round salvages one brilliant sentence from the static
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: shards fall faster and decoy fragments multiply
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: neon ghost text on void black

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Thread a wisp of fog through narrow clear gaps in an autumn skyline before the wind tears your path apart.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: one clean route through the gap feels like exhaling
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: wind gusts reshape gaps mid-stroke and shrink the safe corridor
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: watercolor fog over muted orange rooftops

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Reorder shortcut tiles on a locking phone screen to boot an agent before the display dims — wrong order resets the stack.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: satisfying agent-online ping when the sequence clicks
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: more tile types appear and the lock timer shrinks each round
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: glassmorphism phone UI with pulsing status LEDs

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Two parallel AI brains each predict your next tap — alternate left and right to keep both in sync before their rhythms diverge.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: syncing both brains triggers a harmonic burst
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: patterns desync and tempo accelerates mid-round
